text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, Trainer?! I've got myself a
new fan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She's still just a little girl, but as soon as
she saw
me singing downtown, she said
she fell in love!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? She was even
wearing
ribbons that matched mine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe in a few years, we can even be in
an idol
group together? Yeah! Let's
make that happen!
